positions.name: ProbeMemoryCarriesEnrollmentAssertion
positions.frame: what is this probe memory for, and what does its existence claim about reviewer enrollment in the e2e suite?
positions.why: Both expressions read as one directional move: src-1 states what the e2e suite verifies (creator becomes reviewer on save), and src-2 immediately frames the present artifact — this very memory — as existing solely to carry that verified claim. The register and relational directional reads (native pipeline-test vocabulary, authority-ranking enrollment) land on both segments identically, which is the evidence the two cohere as one read rather than two independent assertions. No tension to hold — the second segment is purely instrumental to the first, not a counter-claim.
